review.notes: Triage review of all 55 physical pages: full structural/fence scan (balanced), automated normalized 4-gram containment diff of every PDF page against the OCR markdown, then manual inspection of every low-hit page. Low ratios were explained by figure-internal chart text (Figures 1-3, 5-10, 12-16) and by HTML tables whose values match the PDF cell-for-cell (Tables 1, 2, 7, 8, 10, 18, 26, 27 spot-verified). Line-by-line review covered the author list, the appendix B.1-B.7 tail, the section 4.3-4.7 region and the reference entry/URL/DOI census (18/18 DOIs, no dropped entries). Body text and reference URLs were additionally verified on 300-dpi renders of physical pages 7, 41, 48, 50 and 53. Markdown escape defects (\_ inside printed underscores) were confirmed against the PDF text layer and renders. Coverage is partial because most reference entries and mid-report prose were machine-scanned rather than read line-by-line.

unresolved.evidence: Reference entries on physical pages 39-49 were verified by census (18/18 doi strings, URL counts, arXiv-preprint counts, entry-paragraph integrity) and the automated 4-gram page diff rather than a line-by-line reading of every entry; a full read could still find small in-entry misreads.

Remaining result tables were spot-checked (Tables 1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 10, 18, 26, 27) rather than compared cell-by-cell; OCR HTML tables here flatten cell boundaries, so a cell-level audit is needed before any structural table repair.
